title: Publish new version
outOfScope: Changing runtime security boundaries or implementing a security sandbox
Changing release workflow policy, branch protection, signing infrastructure, or SBOM/provenance generators
Publishing a release before all release preflight, CI, supply-chain, installer, Japanese, and human-authorization gates pass
Deleting historical Work Item evidence or execution plans

Candidate release identity and candidate supply-chain evidence projection.
Canonical release lifecycle state and candidate source identity.
Authoritative provider-side release, source binding, evidence, asset, and publication sequence.
Fail-closed release freeze, source, archive, and lifecycle preflight implementation.
User-authorized serial Work Item order, mandatory WI-16 Japanese gate, WI-17 Trust Layer gate, and complete lifecycle.
Mandatory pre-release Japanese capability assessment and bounded evidence.
Mandatory pre-release Human-Agent Trust Layer authority and evidence boundaries.
Repository-required Contract, verification, PR, archive, and branch-cleanup lifecycle.
Requested-operation policy must explicitly represent the authorized public release operation.

riskAssessment.reason: Publishing creates externally visible immutable tag and assets; every identity, archive, installer, supply-chain, CI, Japanese, and human decision gate must be source-bound and fail closed.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized serial execution including release publication, provided each Work Item completes its full PR/merge/archive/branch-cleanup lifecycle, and requires fail-closed handling.

preReviewWarnings: Do not publish a candidate, historical, or stale release identity. Record the exact source commit, tag, archive, SBOM, provenance, vulnerability/secret checks, installer verification, public URL, checksums, provider run IDs, and human authorization.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: WI-16 Japanese capability assessment and WI-17 multilingual Human-Agent Trust Layer are verified as merged and closed predecessors before publication.
The release candidate identity is explicit: source commit, tag target, metadata commit, release tag, previous release, and base branch are recorded and equal where required.
The release freeze is finalized only after Work Item closure and clean main synchronization; check-release-preflight passes against the exact source commit.
Release archive, installer digest, SBOM, provenance, vulnerability/secret scanning, hosted CI evidence, and release-digest checks are generated and bound to the exact source commit and release tag.
The provider release is published only once, with the exact version, tag, public URL, release asset names, asset checksums, workflow/run identifiers, and human release authorization recorded.

Post-publication verification confirms the public tag, assets, archive checksum, installer quick-install behavior, compatibility, and evidence bundle; candidate, historical, and published states are not conflated.

The complete Work Item lifecycle succeeds: Contract, preflight, implementation/release operation, verification, Summary, PR, CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch deletion, clean worktree, and origin/main synchronization.
Any process issue encountered is recorded in the execution plan; if it is a workflow defect, the workflow is corrected and re-verified before publication continues.
guidelines: Release claims must be backed by source-bound evidence rather than self-declaration.
Do not publish when any required release gate is missing, stale, contradictory, or unverifiable.
Preserve the distinction between SBOM delegated domain evidence and AI Cockpit governance evidence.
Keep release identity and evidence machine-readable and reproducible.

intent.problem: The remediation sequence requires one real new version publication after the Japanese capability gate and multilingual Human-Agent Trust Layer gate, but release truth must remain bound to one exact source commit and must not be inferred from candidate or historical metadata.
constraints: Use the latest synchronized origin/main after WI-17 closure as the release Work Item base.
Follow the repository release workflow and fail closed on every preflight, CI, evidence, installer, compatibility, and human-decision gate.
Do not claim enterprise compliance, sandboxing, signing, identity, or isolation capabilities that are not evidenced.
Do not delete historical evidence or execution plans in this Work Item.
intent.rationale: A real release is the only way to validate that the converged governance, Japanese, documentation, installer, and supply-chain evidence paths remain aligned at publication time.

rawUserRequest: 继续执行已授权的 AI Cockpit 全面整改计划。WI-18 必须在 WI-16 全面日语评估和 WI-17 Human-Agent Trust Layer 工单完成并关闭后发布新版本；发布前必须走 release freeze、release preflight、PR/CI、SBOM、provenance、漏洞/secret 检查、安装器与兼容性验证、版本/标签/资产/校验和/证据记录及人类授权。每个工单都必须完成完整 PR、合并、归档、清理分支和同步 main 的生命周期；遇到流程问题要记录，流程问题先修流程再继续。

declaredIntent.summary: Publish the next source-bound AI Cockpit template version only after all mandatory governance and evidence gates pass.

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish one new source-bound public release after all mandatory gates pass; no gate bypass authorized.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A stale, candidate, historical, or conflicting release identity is detected.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Release preflight fails closed and no tag or public asset is created.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: WI-16 Japanese evaluation or WI-17 Trust Layer predecessor is not merged and closed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Work Item stops before publication and records the missing predecessor evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Archive, installer, SBOM, provenance, secret/vulnerability, CI, or compatibility evidence is missing or does not match the exact source commit.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The relevant gate fails closed and publication does not proceed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All deterministic gates pass and the user-authorized release operation is executed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The public release is verified by exact tag, asset, checksum, URL, and evidence records, then the Work Item lifecycle is closed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A workflow/process defect is found during release execution.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Record the issue, correct the workflow in a separate appropriately scoped change or stop, rerun the affected gates, and do not continue on stale evidence.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized serial remediation, release publication, and correction of workflow/policy defects before continuing; no gate bypass is authorized.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
